_README: Copy this file to tests/race_magnets.json and fill it in. The real file is
gitignored; only this example is committed.
healthy: three LARGE, permanently well-seeded, LEGAL torrents. Linux ISO
magnets (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora) are ideal - they are fast, they stay
seeded for years, and nothing about the harness cares what is inside.
Large matters: the race needs candidates that are still downloading
after the 90 s grace period, or the scenario is over before any cull
dead: three WELL-FORMED magnets with an info-hash nobody is seeding. Make
them up - 40 random hex characters is a valid v1 info-hash. These must
reach qBittorrent and park in metaDL, which is exactly the case the
120 s no-metadata kill exists for. A malformed magnet is NOT a
substitute: it fails at the add and never enters the race at all.
size/seeders are what an indexer would have advertised. They only affect
the quality pre-score and the ordering of the shortlist, so rough is fine.
